budget_approval: 300s online, 600s worker, 6GiB measured peak RSS and15s hard-termination grace accepted for implementation; execution remains held until tests, commit, immutable source and explicit release.

budget_rationale.atomic_overshoot: Cooperative deadline; preserve actual overshoot/last operation. Hard termination or incomplete export remains ineligible.
budget_rationale.illustration: 3 measured panels + 6 measured initial clones; different learner read pattern, wrapper/logging and stochastic routes remain unmeasured
budget_rationale.online: Initial full selection, optimization, one update, later full selection, online factories/clones/resets/integrity/previews/traces/accounting and intermediate checkpoint exports within current learner timing contract.
budget_rationale.outside_online: Source and initialization, last checkpoint export, independent native audit, final publication, parent process overhead; every component and full elapsed disclosed.
budget_rationale.setup: Template cold construction, source load/snapshot and one learner shape-probe clone+optimization reset plus policy/optimizer/contract initialization reported separately; no transition or score from shape probe.

execution_order: freeze tested exact source and verify declaration/source/model/worlds before optimizer
initialize seed11 scratch RAW and verify preflight initial policy hash
initial full selection panel on both prescribed worlds
two complete optimization episodes on first two manifest seeds
updated full selection panel on both same selection worlds
freeze initial/latest/selected checkpoint and all histories
independent native history audit of six completed episodes, exact-history dedup only
publish only after every receipt and worker/launcher gate completes

failure_policy.incomplete_panel_or_update: no pilot candidate, even if initial panel completed
failure_policy.initial_checkpoint_retained_after_valid_: honest valid selection outcome; no improvement claim
failure_policy.zero_actor_change: negative integration outcome even if critic changed

constructor_initialization.interpretation: deterministic initial inventory preparation only; no optimization or selection score

action_model.feasibility: complete native tool preview required; no uncertified proposal is an action
action_model.identity: new decision-model and proposal-model hashes persisted before greedy episode

logging_implementation_gate.forced_no_forward: record absent outputs with reason when the existing forced-STOP branch performs no policy forward
logging_implementation_gate.join: durable attempted decision precedes step and joins accounting by explicit episode/decision order; trace alone never proves execution

joined_provenance_fields.policy_hash: initial checkpoint at update0, latest checkpoint at update1; joined after freeze, not captured inside forward
joined_provenance_fields.profile_hash: frozen checkpoint profile joined by update identity

logging_implementation_gate.observer_export_failure: fail before attempted transition; preserve previous trace and receipt

optional_derived_fields.probabilities: may be calculated from saved masked logits afterward; label derived and preserve calculation, never label as captured distribution tensor

logging_implementation_gate.seam: optional common learner and rollout observer after already-computed forward/action, before step; copied primitive records only
logging_implementation_gate.serialization: finite legal logits; masked negative infinity encoded as string -inf with mask; arrays retain dtype/shape/values; no live autograd/model/simulator objects
logging_implementation_gate.status: separate supported observer and accounting implementation in progress; requires independent tests before execution

purpose: Validate one complete patient-specific RAW actor update, selection, durable accounting and independent geometry pipeline; not estimate efficacy.
release_gates: tested supported decision observer and accounting linkage
tiny actual2episode1update pipeline and failure gates
integrated regressions on exact immutable source
root commit/source snapshot and explicit execution release
selection_rule: maximum full-panel mean deterministic return; earliest checkpoint wins ties
source_binding: Before execution record tested commit, exact executable source bytes and runtime/dependency versions in immutable snapshot; assert unchanged physical decision/native/proposal identities and declaration hashes before optimizer.
success_and_candidate_gates: successful worker and launcher final states with hash-bound final exports
one finite Adam step from exactly two complete optimization episodes
finite positive actor gradient and changed actor parameter hash
two complete selection rows at updates0and1, each2worlds and matching checkpoint identity
one retained zero-transition setup reset; no incomplete decision-bearing episode
complete accounting counts and no committed-but-unreturned transitions
generic optimization/selection counters equal corresponding authenticated returned transitions
complete actual online decision trace joined to every attempted step
independent geometry accepted for all six completed histories after freeze
only runner grants candidate eligibility; accounting receipt stays ineligible
